name: Mosaic
provenance: UC San Diego Facilities floor plans, converted for the classroom explorer. Rooms are listed by floor only (no room outlines). Added 0113, 0114 from the retained public FIS raster. New geometry is manually traced and approximately registered; existing rooms and levels are retained.

coordinateSystem.description: Meters from the center of the building's campus-map footprint.

sources.title: UC San Diego Campus Map, building footprints and heights
UCSD Facilities Information System - NTPLL - Mosaic - First Floor - Master Plan
sources.publisher: UC San Diego Facilities Information System
notes: Native stitched raster; manually reviewed room labels and boundaries.

Only the three scheduled rooms MO0113, MO0114 and MO0204 are traced. Official FIS room-tree labels and areas establish the MO building prefix and the leading-zero schedule keys. L1 raster text is overprinted, so the retained HTML listing corroborates its labels.
Doorway jambs, thin wall widths and small column details are simplified; adjacent projection/support rooms are excluded. Metric scale and campus position remain approximate.

L1 uses four campus-footprint controls with three independent facade holdouts. L2 uses the same pixel frame, checked against the common southwest and southeast stair cores and northwestern exterior corner; it is not a separate survey fit.
All seven original floor levels and approximate campus-footprint slabs are retained. The partial classroom geometry does not describe all floor areas or an as-built interior.
The public FIS plans dated 2023-09-01 warn that displayed drawings may be out of date.
